name: Tartaros Sanctum
card_quote: "I like CT but I can't commit to playing every day. I want something more laid back."
card_desc: → Sanctum has you covered. No large requirements — just show up, use some of your attacks, and enjoy the event. We still aim for top 100, but we understand that real life doesn't pause for CT.
modal_quote: "I like CT but I can't commit to playing every day. I want something more laid back."
modal_desc: Sanctum is for the player who enjoys CT but can't — or simply doesn't want to — grind every single day. Real life doesn't pause for CT week, and we completely understand that. You'll still be part of a team aiming for top 100, still contributing and enjoying the event, just without the pressure of strict daily requirements. Show up, use some of your attacks, enjoy the ride.
requirements: Some ticket usage — you don't need to use all of them, but contribute where you can
Heads up if inactive — just let us know if you're going to miss an event
Respectful attitude — that's really all we ask
Basic Discord check-ins — no need to be online constantly, just stay loosely in the loop
